description:
Five girls. Five elements. An unforgettable adventure.

Discover a magical visual novel filled with excitement, friendship, and a destiny to fulfill. Five girls from different parts of the world awaken to the power of the elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Light. Together, they will travel through spectacular settings filled with color and mystery, where they will meet wonderful characters and face challenges that will test their courage and unity.

· Vibrant Illustrations – Colorful backgrounds and expressive characters come to life in every scene.

· Enchanting Music – A magical soundtrack that will immerse you in this grand adventure.

· A Thrilling Story – Discover a tale filled with values, courage, and true friendship.

· Adorable Characters – Encounter many beautiful characters throughout the adventure that the girls must contend with.

· Explore, feel, and live in a magical world. The magic of the elements awaits!
name: Elemental Princesses: Super Magical Quest
intro: Five girls from different corners of the world discover that they possess the essence of the elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Air and Light.
